title: ADIP Assistance for Purchase/Fitting of Aids & Appliances
provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (Govt of India)
benefitSummary: Provides free or subsidized durable assistive devices (hearing aids, wheelchairs, prosthetics, braille equipment) up to Rs. 15,000.
applicationSteps: Visit nearest ALIMCO or District Disability Center
Submit filled ADIP application form with documents
Undergo physical evaluation by medical expert
Receive free custom fitted assistive device

title: NHFDC Self-Employment & Skill Loan Scheme
provider: National Handicapped Finance and Development Corporation
benefitSummary: Loans up to Rs. 25 Lakhs at low interest rate (4% to 8% p.a.) for setting up small business, education, or skill training.
applicationSteps: Apply online via NHFDC portal or State Channelizing Agency
Submit project cost estimate and business proposal
Loan disbursement directly to bank account

title: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
benefitSummary: Monthly pension allowance paid directly to severe disability holders living below poverty line.
applicationSteps: Obtain application form from Gram Panchayat / Municipal Office
Attach medical board certificate and BPL proof
Monthly pension credited directly to bank account

title: Scholarship for Students with Disabilities (Pre & Post Matric)
provider: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
benefitSummary: Annual maintenance allowance, book grant, and disability allowance up to Rs. 4,000/month for students in classes 9 to Higher Education.
applicationSteps: Select Disability Scholarship Scheme and upload documents
Scholarship disbursed via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)
